This supports the Router's texture_anomaly observation. The topology_boundary_auditor found a high mask confidence (0.98), but this only means the segmentation model found a coherent region, not that the boundaries are artifact-free. The perceptual_quality_auditor found no graphics-level distortions, but this doesn't rule out structural artifacts. I agree with the Router's severity ratings, though the texture anomaly might be slightly more severe (2.5) given the classifier's confusion with curtains.
